data.long_meaning: Vaibhavansh is a powerful name that signifies prosperity, victory, and the son of a god. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vaibhava', which means 'manifestation' or 'prosperity'. This name is often given to boys in Hindu communities to bless them with success, good fortune, and divine protection. The name Vaibhavansh carries the meaning “Prosperity, Victory, Son of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vaibhavansh usually hope their child will grow to embody prosperity, victory, son of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Vaibhavansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prosperity, Victory, Son of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vaibhavansh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.context: During this period, the Vaibhavan Shah rulers were known for their patronage of Jainism and the construction of several Jain temples in the region. One of the most famous temples built during this time is the Adinath Temple at Mount Abu.

historical_references.reference: Another prominent member of the Vaibhavan Shah dynasty was Vaghela Raja Vijayasimha, who ruled from 1244 to 1268 AD. He is known for his military conquests and expansion of the kingdom's territory.
historical_references.context: During his reign, Vaghela Raja Vijayasimha successfully defeated the Chalukyas and the Yadavas, thereby extending the territorial boundaries of the Vaibhavan Shah kingdom. He is also known to have erected several public works, including reservoirs, tanks, and wells, to cater to the needs of the populace.
